spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Function definition; Supports required-params
## Statements: Assignment; Compound Assignment; Call; While; Local variable declarations; Return
## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only; `Call`; Variable reference
## Operators: Multiplicative ops `*`, `%`, `/`; Relational ops `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`; Additive ops `+`, `-`; numeric ops `+`, `-`
reason: All constructs are supported: integer literals, unary negation, required-parameter function calls, local variables, while iteration, multiplication, comparison, compound addition, return and integer division. The loop computes (-2)^63 without exceeding the signed integer range; dividing that minimum integer by -1 overflows and the @panic assertion exercises supported integer division semantics. No applicable restriction excludes this behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic marker asserts overflow at val1 / val; earlier multiplications remain representable. There are no @args or @output assertions.
